🤖 RailOptima Field Dispatcher
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Quick Commands:
  1 / ACK  — Accept work order
  START    — Take track possession
  DONE     — Certify line fit
  STATUS   — Live train ETA
  DELAY    — Request +15 min extension
  DEFECT   — Report rail defect
Or ask any Indian Railways operations question.
